messages:
elaine_billing: Noticed a surge of webhook 429/backoff retries from Stripe overnight; several invoice.update events were retried and our NetSuite importer logged duplicate-id conflicts for 23 invoices. net-sync-bot: import-job-20241201 failed: NS_ERR_DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_ID for external_invoice_id inv_20241201_23..45.

matt_backend: We pushed a change to webhook backoff handling last week to exponential with jitter. Looks like retries sometimes replayed the same event payload with same external_id but without idempotency token because our receiver dropped empty Idempotency header on retry. That caused the import to attempt a second create instead of patch.

ops_bot: Deploy history: webhook-receiver v3 deployed 2024-11-28 02:14 UTC. Change: reject blank headers earlier in pipeline.

elaine_billing: Business impact: 23 invoices flagged as duplicate in NetSuite; some were created as drafts then second create failed. AR hold for those customers until we confirm. Sample customers: FluxGrid, HarborTech.

francisco_ar: If NetSuite already has a draft or posted invoice, the second create should have been idempotent. Why didn't our importer dedupe?

matt_backend: Our importer uses external_invoice_id + idempotency_key. If idempotency_key absent, it falls back to external_invoice_id only when creating, but because the incoming payload had slightly different invoice_line ordering it bypassed the existing-match path and attempted a create. We need stricter dedupe: canonicalize payload before match and always check external_invoice_id first.

riley_cs: Any customer-visible impact? Did anyone get double-charged?

elaine_billing: No double charges in Stripe. Problem is NetSuite state only; revenue recognition could be wrong if we leave drafts. We need to reconcile NetSuite drafts vs Stripe charges.

matt_backend: Fix plan: 1) revert header-drop rule in receiver to preserve Idempotency-Key if present (hotfix) 2) add canonicalization + strong external_invoice_id first lookup in importer 3) run a reconciliation sweep to detect duplicate NS drafts and mark legit ones for merge or remove. I'll handle 1 & 2. ETA 2 hours for hotfix, 6 hours for importer patch.

francisco_ar: I'll start a reconciliation sheet and request approvals for any NetSuite deletes/merges. We should not delete without AR sign-off.

net-sync-bot: reconcile-sweep-20241201 queued. Scanning NetSuite for invoices with duplicate external_invoice_id...

net-sync-bot: reconcile-sweep-20241201 report: 23 duplicate groups found. 18 safe-to-merge (identical amounts & tax), 5 require manual review (line item mismatch). See sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/finance/webhook-dup-sweep-20241201.

ops_bot: Hotfix deployed: receiver now preserves empty Idempotency-Key headers and logs missing key instances. Monitoring for replays enabled.

matt_backend: Imported canonicalization patch merged to staging. Re-run on a small sample shows idempotent behavior. Queuing backfill reattach job for the 18 safe groups.

francisco_ar: Approved auto-merge for the 18 safe groups; manual review started for 5. I'll notify CS for affected accounts.

elaine_billing: Thanks all. Action items: (1) postmortem draft (Matt/Francisco), (2) add test for header-preservation + retry handling (Matt), (3) alert if >0 duplicate-imports appear in nightly run (Ops). Will update leadership. :thumbsup:
